bug_semantics: Authenticated Jolokia exec of BrokerView.addNetworkConnector(String) accepts a discovery URI whose outer scheme is masterslave. MasterSlaveDiscoveryAgentFactory parses that URI as a composite (parentheses optional) and MasterSlaveDiscoveryAgent.configureServices rewrites the inner components into failover:(inner1,inner2)?.... When an inner component is vm://...?brokerConfig=xbean:<resource>, VMTransportFactory loads a Spring ResourceXmlApplicationContext; singleton beans are instantiated before BrokerService validates the configuration, so factory methods such as Runtime.exec() run in the broker JVM. After CVE-2026-34197, BrokerView.DENIED_TRANSPORT_SCHEMES blocked vm (and later static/failover/http) but omitted masterslave, so a no-paren wrapper such as masterslave:vm://...?brokerConfig=...,tcp://... passed validateAllowedUrl because URISupport.isCompositeURI required a leading '(' and only the outer scheme was checked.
flaw_origin: The CVE-named trigger is the masterslave discovery scheme. AMQ-3564 commit 9ba8d2681f0c241a36163a3a14e6cc839e53aba2 (2011-10-25) first added MasterSlaveDiscoveryAgent/Factory plus the META-INF discoveryagent/masterslave SPI, which unwraps attacker-controlled inner URIs and wraps them as failover:(...). At that commit, BrokerView.addNetworkConnector(String) already forwarded the raw discovery string with no scheme check (AMQ-1444, 2007), and vm://?brokerConfig=xbean: already loaded a broker XML config (2005). Later 2026 denylist patches for CVE-2026-34197/CVE-2026-40466 are incomplete mitigations of this pre-existing wrapper, not the first write of the mechanism.

reasoning: CVE-2026-42588 is a real Apache CNA/GHSA code-injection issue, not withdrawn. The lifecycle is Jolokia exec of addNetworkConnector with a masterslave discovery URI that still reaches VMTransportFactory.brokerConfig and instantiates attacker Spring XML before config validation. The smallest first-write of that unique wrapper is AMQ-3564 9ba8d2681f0c241a36163a3a14e6cc839e53aba2: it added the masterslave SPI and the agent that parses composite inner URIs and rewrites them to failover:(...). Parent f4df288872bc5e140301b7c764faa53037f73dff lacks those files, the commit has a single parent, and later activemq-core to activemq-client relocation is a move, not a BIC. Unvalidated JMX addNetworkConnector (2007) and vm brokerConfig (2005) already existed, so the 2011 scheme immediately became a management-plane RCE path; Jolokia (2016) only HTTP-bridged that existing MBean. 2026 BrokerView denylists that omitted masterslave are incomplete CVE-2026-34197/40466 mitigations and were not used as the BIC (advisory range is all versions before 5.19.7 / 6.2.6, not only post-denylist builds). The closing change is 1f2a2571524c56b3b103a9d3a625ceda3430f6e9 adding masterslave to DENIED_TRANSPORT_SCHEMES, cherry-picked into 5.19.7 and 6.2.6. AI is judged only from the BIC commit object: human author and committer, git-svn trailer only, so verdict is NOT_AI.
